Hallo zusammen,
Wir erweitern unser deutsches Team wieder: 

We’re Hiring – Social Media Community Manager (German Speakers)

Imprint, a social research and strategy company based in Tel Aviv, is looking for German-speaking social media content writers.

We’re especially interested in candidates who made Aliyah from Germany or who speak German at a native level.

Key qualifications:

 • Experience writing for social media platforms

 • Strong research skills and interest in global trends

 • Ability to work independently and as part of a team

 • Proficiency in Microsoft Office

 • Bonus: experience in graphic design or video editing

To apply, send your CV and writing samples to: jobs@imprint-social.com
